map.从 n 个元素取 r 个的组合数。: The number of combinations of r items chosen from n elements.
map.计算从 n 个里选 k 个且不计顺序的选法数，如抽签、组队: Count the ways to choose k out of n without regard to order, e.g. drawing lots or forming teams
map.评估彩票或抽奖的可能结果数量: Estimate the number of possible outcomes in a lottery or raffle
map.在概率题中算事件发生的方式数（分母）: In probability problems, count the number of ways an event can occur (the denominator)
map.从 5 人中选 2 人，组合数 C(5,2)=5!/(2!×3!)=(5×4)/: Choosing 2 people from 5, the combination count C(5,2)=5!/(2!×3!)=(5×4)/(2×1)=10 ways. Unlike permutations, {A,B} and {B,A} count as the same.
map.同样 5 选 2，若顺序有关（如冠亚军）则用排列 P(5,2)=5×4=20，是: For the same 5-choose-2, if order matters (e.g. first and second place) use the permutation P(5,2)=5×4=20, twice the combination, because each pair has two orders.
map.组合和排列的核心区别？: What is the core difference between combinations and permutations?
map.组合不计顺序（选出来即可），排列计顺序（谁先谁后不同）。公式上 C(n,k)=P: Combinations ignore order (just choose them), while permutations count order (who comes first matters). Formally C(n,k)=P(n,k)/k!, i.e. dividing out the orderings.
map.恒成立：从 n 个里选 k 个留下，等价于选 n-k 个拿走，二者一一对应，故: Always: choosing k to keep out of n is equivalent to choosing n−k to remove, a one-to-one correspondence, so C(n,k)=C(n,n−k).
